summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice and proxy materials for an extraordinary general meeting to be held November 24, 2026, at Goldfarb Gross Seligman's Tel-Aviv offices, with a November 5, 2026 record date. The sole proposal is approval of a corporate name change to OptiPhi Computing Ltd. (and a conforming amendment to the amended and restated articles). The board recommends voting FOR. Mechanics are routine: registered holders may vote in person or by proxy card, and street-name holders receive voting instruction cards through their banks or nominees. No transaction, ownership change, or deal terms are present; watch only for the name change's implications.
